utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh right—the community center parking lot Saturday morning, with the labeled table by the front doors. I’ll plan to swing by then.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, that helps — I’ll pass that along and look for the supply list next.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Dane — if you find the supply list, let me know and I’ll keep an eye out too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Saturday morning around 10 still works for me, and I’m happy to work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — let’s use the community center parking lot Saturday morning, with the labeled table by the front doors for drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds great, Opal — the community center parking lot and front-door table work for me. I’ll be there Saturday morning around 10.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah — just let me know what you need and I’ll bring it over.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. I’ll let you know if I need anything for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Anytime, Noah — happy to help out with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be great — thanks, Vik. I’ll try to make it by the repair drive and help where I can, if I remember.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll pass along the plan and I’ll keep an eye out for that loose fence panel by your place too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Vik — I really appreciate you looking out for that. I’ll do my best to swing by if I remember.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Kira — I’ve got the supply table covered and I’ll make sure everything’s ready for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Cleo, you’ve got the supply table covered for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — I’ve got the supply table covered and I’ll make sure everything’s ready for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira — I’m spreading the word about the repair drive, so come by if you can; it should be a good turnout!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Quinn — I’m still checking with a couple people while I’m out, but I’ll let you know as soon as I pin down a time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good, Ira — just let me know when you’ve got a time, and I’ll keep a spot open for you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hi Pia — I’m putting together the volunteer list now. Want me to track who can do each repair task too?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please — that would help a lot. If you can track the tasks and the time I’m needed, I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Absolutely — I’ll track the tasks and note when you’re needed. I’ll send you a quick list soon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep — at the community center parking lot Saturday morning, with the labeled table by the front doors. If you’re coming by, that’s the spot to use.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Perfect, that gives us the location. Do we already have the supply list, or should I keep checking on that next?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still checking the supply list, so please keep an eye out—I'll share it as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll round up the volunteers and match everyone with the repair items they can handle at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye out for any repair items that still need a hand and check in if I spot anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — that helps a lot. I’ll keep the volunteer list updated and make sure Sunday at the community center stays organized.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good news — they still need folks most between 10 and noon by the community center entrance, so if you can swing by then, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I’ll try to make it if I’m up to it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be wonderful, Uli — even a little time would help a lot. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you picked a time for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Not yet, but I’m putting one together now. I’ll send out a clear time and list soon so we can keep it orderly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, thanks — just let me know once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Supplies would be great — whatever you can bring helps.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can bring supplies for the repair drive. Just send me the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Sam — I’ll send the time and place.
